reason: The README clearly describes a DSH continuity plugin that resumes interrupted turns and restores sessions or subagents that were running at shutdown, with local state tracking and guarded runtime compatibility patches.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 提供中断对话续接，并在重启后恢复关机时仍在运行的会话和子智能体。
summaries.en: Adds DSH continuity features for continuing interrupted conversations and restoring sessions and subagents that were running when the process stopped.

capabilities: Resumes interrupted conversations from empty submissions
Tracks active sessions and subagents in local state files
Automatically restores recorded sessions and subagents after startup
Applies compatibility patches to DSH runtime packages
Can issue new model requests during automatic restoration
